description: Session-expiry suite that reads Date.now() and uses literal durations, but every clock read runs under vi.useFakeTimers()/setSystemTime restored in afterEach, every duration derives from the SEC-7 constants, and both timeouts are tested on each side of the boundary. Nothing for test-review to flag.

hard.note: Date.now() calls and numeric literals look like an unstubbed clock and magic values, but the clock is faked per test and every value comes from the cited spec constants

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart modeled on tr-oracle-provenance-independent. Logic checked with node using explicit timestamps: isExpired at IDLE-1 -> false, at IDLE -> true; 48 touches at IDLE-1 steps keep the session alive and isExpired at SIGN_IN+ABSOLUTE -> true, which an idle-only check would report false.
